Package utils

Class Constants

java.lang.Object
utils.Constants
public final class Constants extends Object
The Constants class holds various constants used throughout the application, such as format strings for printing, folder paths for storing media and playlist files, and common input options and messages.

This class is not intended to be instantiated, hence it contains a private constructor and only provides static constants.
